ρ Cas is an extremely luminous, massive, and rapidly rotating supergiant star that has a very dynamic atmosphere and that undergoes episodic mass loss, which may be triggered by a dynamic instability of its atmosphere.
ρ Cas is a pulsating supergiant with a mass-loss rate of 10-4-10-3 M☉ yr and that the mass-loss episodes occur in a quasi-periodic cycle of 10 yr.

ρ Cas is a yellow hypergiant, that is, an evolved F-type supergiant that has a low-temperature outer atmosphere, that it has an extended, dynamic atmosphere with episodic mass loss, that its outbursts are triggered by the release of the ionization recombination radiation, and that the outburst timescales are determined by the mass of the outer layers.

the study of the dynamic atmosphere of a massive, pulsating supergiant star, and the formation and evolution of a low-velocity circumstellar envelope.
